en.title: Number of Promoted Players Under Competition Ranking
en.description:
Players with equal scores share the same rank, and a player's rank is 1 plus the number of players with a strictly higher score. Only players whose rank is ≤k and whose score is not 0 are promoted.

This site independently prepared the standard I/O and the solution; supplements for bounds missing from the source and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n k, and the second line contains n scores. The original bounds are 1≤n≤100000, 0≤score≤100, and k≤n with no lower bound; this site adds −10^9≤k≤n, and no one is promoted when k≤0.
en.explanation: The original example promotes 3 players. The other two examples give 0 and 2 respectively. The sample code in the original summary chapter does not exclude scores of 0 and must not be reused.
hints: Use 101 score buckets and count the players seen from high to low; the rank of the current nonzero score is the number seen so far plus 1.
